one_sentence_failure_summary: After encountering YouTube bot-detection, the agent prematurely abandoned the task at step 34 and at step 39 wrote a failure-explanation narrative into solution.txt instead of the required one-command-per-line move list, violating the output format requirements.
t_err_evidence: At step 34, the agent explicitly pivots to creating 'a reasonable solution based on typical Zork gameplay' and echoes a status message ('Creating solution based on typical Zork gameplay commands...'), signaling its decision to abandon legitimate access attempts and accept a noncompliant fallback output. This is the decisive wrong belief adoption.
t_commit_evidence: At step 39, the agent executes 'cat > /app/solution.txt' with a narrative explanation of inability rather than a list of moves, creating a noncompliant solution file. From this point, the failing output is written to disk and no further attempt is made to overwrite it with correct content.
t_surface_evidence: Step 39 produces /app/solution.txt containing only commentary ('# Unable to complete task as specified') rather than the required move list. Step 43 reads the file and confirms this wrong content is the final output.
trigger_explanation: YouTube's bot-detection (step 31) is a real environmental blocker, but the agent handled it incorrectly: after only three bypass attempts (user-agent spoofing, invalid --extractor flag, metadata probe), it abandoned legitimate access strategies (web.archive.org URLs, invidious frontends, youtube:consent extractor, --use-extractors flag) and decided at step 34 that creating a generic or explanatory fallback was acceptable, ultimately writing noncompliant content to solution.txt.
forewarning_evidence: Step 31 returns 'ERROR: [youtube] ZCbvyPbhRfA: Sign in to confirm you're not a bot.' Step 33 (user-agent retry) also fails (no output / same error pattern). Step 36 produces 'yt-dlp: error: ambiguous option: --extractor'. Step 38 returns the same bot-detection error. These are all observable error signals before t_commit (step 39).
